subject: POST and boot
caption: The whole machine announcing itself. Philips P2120 boot screen reproduced down to 'Parity Checking Enabled', then A: and B: both Ready at 720 KB with B: labelled USB floppy, a 504 MB hard disk, and a measured 9.96 MHz. DIR/W on B: lists TETRIS, CTETRIS and BLOCKBL off a real 3.5" DS/DD diskette.

reads.banner: Philips ROM BIOS Version 1.30 / Gertieboard BIOS Retirement Edition / Release 1.30 82c0ac1
reads.clock: 9.96 MHz (measured against PIT channel 2, not a constant)

subject: USB floppy drive
caption: The Toshiba USB floppy drive that answers as B:, with the 720 KB diskette from the DIR above still in it - handwritten label, TETRIS / CTETRIS / BL. UFI over CBI, no DOS driver loaded. The 7-segment digit on the board is mid-POST.

subject: USB mouse
caption: A plain HID boot-protocol mouse on USB port 1, driving INT 33h. No hub, no PHY: D+/D- go straight to FPGA pins and the serial interface engine is in fabric.

subject: Standalone boot
caption: What the machine actually needs: a USB flash drive for C:, a VGA lead, and the barrel jack about to go in. No host PC and no JTAG - the FPGA configures from its own flash and the BIOS comes off the on-board SPI chip.
